mil3.3.4:0.3: The Question on Whether Conditions are Produced
mil3.3.4:1.2: “Venerable Nagasena, are there conditions that are produced?”
mil3.3.4:1.3: “Yes, Great King, there are conditions that are produced.”
mil3.3.4:1.5: “With the eye in existence, Great King, there is eye consciousness among visible forms; with eye consciousness in existence there is contact through the eye; with contact through the eye in existence there is feeling; with feeling in existence there is craving; with craving in existence there is clinging; with clinging in existence there is being; with being in existence there is birth; with birth in existence, aging and death come to be along with sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and distress. This is the origin of the entire mass of suffering.
mil3.3.4:1.6: With the eye absent, Great King, there is no eye consciousness among visible forms; with eye consciousness absent there is no contact through the eye; with contact through the eye absent there is no feeling; with feeling absent there is no craving; with craving absent there is no clinging; with clinging absent there is no being; with being absent there is no birth; with birth absent, aging and death do not come to be along with sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and distress. This is the cessation of the entire mass of suffering.”
